findings.title: website_name bypasses the anonymous TL0 profile-field restriction
findings.body: `website_name` is serialized as a normal attribute but is not included in `untrusted_attributes`. For an anonymous viewer of a TL0 user, `website` is correctly omitted by `scope.restrict_user_fields?`, yet the new attribute still derives and returns its hostname (and, for matching domains, its path) from the hidden website value. This exposes information that the existing restriction deliberately withholds. Add `website_name` to the restricted attributes and make its inclusion use the same guard as `website`.

findings.title: The website-name inclusion predicate has the wrong serializer method name
findings.body: The serializer inclusion convention used throughout this class is `include_<attribute>?` (for example `include_email?` and `include_card_image_badge?`), but this method is named `include_website_name` without the trailing `?`. It therefore will not be consulted as the inclusion predicate, so `website_name` can be emitted as `null` for users without a website rather than being omitted as intended. Rename it to `include_website_name?` (and apply the appropriate visibility restriction there).
